_note: FICTIONAL EXAMPLE. Shows the shape of a spec and which Jira statements map to which field. The product, key, IDs and numbers are invented for illustration. Never reuse this wording for a real ticket.

paragraphs: The goal of this test plan is to ensure the quality, functionality, and reliability of the Acme Loyalty Points service (https://loyalty.example.com/), as described in the requirement recorded in Jira issue LOY-7.
The requirement states that customers earn points on purchases and redeem them at checkout.

scope.title: Functional Testing
points: Verify requirements LOY-R1 to LOY-R3: earn points (LOY-R1), redeem points (LOY-R2), view balance (LOY-R3).
Test coverage follows the priorities given in the requirement: High (LOY-R1, LOY-R2) and Medium (LOY-R3).

scope.title: Performance Testing
points: Verify that the points balance loads within 3 seconds (Non-Functional Requirement: Performance).
Number of concurrent users: Insufficient information to determine.

inclusions.title: Earning points (LOY-R1)
points: LOY-R1 (High): Verify that a completed purchase adds points to the customer's balance.
Points per currency unit: Insufficient information to determine.

inclusions.title: Redeeming points (LOY-R2)
points: LOY-R2 (High): Verify that points can be applied at checkout to reduce the order total.

inclusions.title: Points balance view (LOY-R3)
points: LOY-R3 (Medium): Verify that the customer can see the current points balance.

risks.risk: Points calculation depends on a third-party pricing feed
risks.mitigation: Use a stubbed feed in the test environment.

risks.risk: Redemption rules may change late in the sprint
